text: A student shall not register for more than 26 credits in any semester during the first two years (Semesters 1–4), unless granted explicit permission by the Dean (Academics).
conditions: Maximum credit load per semester; exceeding requires written Dean approval.

text: A student shall not register for fewer than 12 credits in any regular semester, except in the final semester or under medical/special circumstances approved by the Dean (Academics).
applies_to: B.Tech all programmes, all regular semesters
conditions: Minimum credit load per regular semester; exceptions require Dean approval.

text: In the third year onwards (Semesters 5–8), a student in good standing (CGPA ≥ 7.0) may register for up to 28 credits in a semester with prior approval.

text: IIT Bhilai permits students to earn academic credit by completing NPTEL/SWAYAM courses, subject to prior approval from the Department Academic Committee (DAC) and the Academic Office. The number of credits transferable is determined by the credit equivalence policy.
conditions: Prior approval required; course must be approved before enrolment. Credit equivalence subject to departmental assessment.

text: A student who completes a NPTEL/SWAYAM course with a minimum score as specified by the NPTEL portal (typically ≥ 40% in the proctored exam) and submits the certificate to the Academic Office within the specified deadline is eligible for credit transfer consideration.
applies_to: B.Tech all programmes seeking NPTEL credit transfer
conditions: Must achieve minimum passing score in NPTEL proctored examination; certificate submission deadline must be met.
document_name: IIT Bhilai UG Manual / Academic Regulations
notes: The 40% minimum score threshold is the standard NPTEL passing criterion commonly referenced at multiple IITs; verify against the specific IIT Bhilai UG Manual for the exact threshold.

text: NPTEL/SWAYAM credits earned and transferred to the academic record may be counted towards elective credit requirements of the B.Tech programme, but generally may not substitute for core programme courses without special approval.
conditions: NPTEL credits count towards electives, not cores, unless specially approved.
document_name: IIT Bhilai UG Manual / Academic Regulations
notes: Manually transcribed from IIT Bhilai UG Academic Manual.

text: IIT Bhilai follows a 10-point grading scale. The passing grade in a course is D (5 grade points). A student obtaining F (0 grade points) has failed the course and must repeat it.
conditions: Minimum passing grade is D (grade point 5); F grade requires course repetition.
